## Highlights
### Fixed
- A tab that plays sound or video, has a video in Picture in Picture, even paused, or uses your camera or microphone stays open and loaded however long you are away from it. - Pages in a Space you leave rest like background tabs, and coming back shows them, split views included, the way switching to their tab does, without taking focus from the address field or the command palette. - Chromium never freezes a background tab that plays sound or video, has a video in Picture in Picture, even paused, or uses your camera, microphone or screen.
---
